name: SoundMax Pro
reviews: Amazing sound quality and comfortable fit.
Battery drains fast during calls.
Great value for this price.

name: AirMax 3000
reviews: Powerful bass and clear vocals.
A little tight for long sessions.

name: ZenBuds Lite
reviews: Very lightweight and portable.
Mic quality is average outdoors.

name: VisionTab S10
reviews: Smooth performance for study and streaming.

reviews: Accurate step tracking and great battery.

name: HomeBeat Mini

reviews: Very smooth tracking and responsive clicks.

reviews: Excellent tactile feedback for typing.
